topic: By using antenna trainer, observe, measure output and radiation pattern on following antenna: - Half wave simple dipole antenna, Quarter wave
syllabus_extract: By using antenna trainer, observe, measure output and radiation pattern on following antenna: - Half wave simple dipole antenna, Quarter wave simple dipole antenna & Half wave folded dipole with reflector antenna.
specific_objectives: 30.1.1.1 Trainee should be able to practical on various lab FTL, RF & Embedded lab.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Operation of Antenna Trainer to measure output and observe radiation patterns for Half Wave Simple Dipole, Quarter Wave Simple Dipole, and Half Wave Folded Dipole with Reflector. Safety: Ensure RF power is off before connecting cables. Instructor supervision required during measurement.
intro_questions: What is the fundamental difference between a half-wave and a quarter-wave antenna?
Define the term 'radiation pattern' in the context of antenna theory.
List the three specific antenna types to be practiced in this session.

summary_questions: Explain how the radiation pattern of a quarter-wave dipole differs from a half-wave dipole.
Describe the role of the reflector in a folded dipole antenna system.
Summarize the key measurements taken for each of the three antenna types.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the theoretical radiation patterns of the Half Wave Simple Dipole and the Half Wave Folded Dipole with Reflector based on the session observations.
